title: Extremely Short Swords PVP
description: This pack will give you extremely short swords into the game. it is very good for PVP players and also casual players can use it as well
body: PVP Texture Pack made for players by players. This texture pack updates the swords in Minecraft with a extremely short look, giving each sword a unique and visually appealing design. Perfect for PvP players and anyone who wants to enhance their combat experience. Also great for casual players
